body:
Independent follow-up to #358. Compare SQLite and MariaDB through public snekql transactions and SQLAlchemy ORM sessions.

Investigate invalid assignment and update rejection stages, omitted versus explicit NULL patch fields, transaction/session reuse after a failed write, object state after commit/rollback versus independent reads, and decoding of externally corrupted rows.

Keep idiomatic behavior separate from added validation policies. The specification is the oracle, not either library. Use isolated databases and test-first research checks; retain runnable probes and observed evidence. No package fixes, literal-default design decisions, or merging previous PRs.
title: Research updates, failure recovery, and corrupted-row reads versus SQLAlchemy
